_doc: Mocked specs the pre-push runs on every change to app code, because the coverage map cannot see all they execute (ETP-5891). Entry: {file: 'tests/…mocked.spec.js', reason}. scripts/select-mocked-specs.js reads it; the PR and the cut run every spec anyway.

specs.reason: Opens more pages with context.newPage(); coverage only records the test's own page.
